annotations.text: The heat rail is the signature: repeat frequency reads as temperature before you read a word. Cool grey = asked once, amber = 3x, hot coral = 5x+. It carries through to the dots on the printed paper.
Ink and paper: the app is deep navy, the paper is warm cream. Primary buttons are paper-coloured, so the action that makes a paper looks like paper.
Review is the honesty mechanism. Every extracted question is shown against the scan with its confidence, and proposed merges are offered rather than applied silently.
